test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 18 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Three of the following statements pertaining to non-biodegradable plastics indicate their implications on animals, plants and our surrounding. Choose the odd one out.

options.text: Plastic bags are durable carry bags
Can prove fatal when eaten by animals
Reduce the fertility of the soil

solution:
The correct answer is** __Plastic bags are durable carry bags__.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

 
• ** Non- biodegradable plastics** cause a huge **threat **to animals, plants, and our surroundings which include:

 
 
• Choking the drains.
 
• Fatal to animals when eaten.
 
• Reduce the fertility of the soil, etc.
 
 
 
• While having disadvantages, it also has an **advantage** that non-biodegradable plastics are durable carry bags. 
 
• Hence, out of all the four, **statement 2 is odd one out**, as it is the advantage of non-biodegradable plastics, while others are not.
